outcome: placental transport rate (PTR) of IgG antibodies
concentration of IgG antibodies in umbilical cord blood serum (UCS)
placental transport rate (PTR) of antineutrophil cytoplasmatic antibodies against lactoferrin (Lf-ANCA)
concentration of Lf-ANCA in umbilical cord blood serum (UCS)
cohort: The study included 101 pregnant women and their healthy CS-delivered newborn children.
finding: Maternal excessive pre-pregnancy BMI (pBMI) and gestational weight gain (GWG) are associated with unfavorable immune marker profiles (lower beneficial IgG and higher detrimental Lf-ANCA) in umbilical cord blood serum of CS-delivered newborns, with effects more pronounced in male newborns and when both pBMI and GWG are excessive.
